title: Site Header
description: A marketing-site header with an announcement line, a floating navbar and a native drawer on small screens.
summary: Announcement, navbar and a command-driven mobile drawer.
notes: Below 56rem the inline links are replaced by a menu button that opens a native dialog drawer with command="show-modal" / commandfor. Browsers without invoker commands show the button but do not open the drawer.
The desktop and mobile navigations are separate lists, as the Actual CSS navbar guide recommends. Keep their links and aria-current in sync.
Links are placeholder fragments; the current page is marked with aria-current="page".
